status_semantics: A task is VERIFIED only once its CI has actually been read and passed. NEX-090 is NOT VERIFIED: its product commit aa4b2c8 is pushed but no CI verdict has been read, so it appears in neither completed_tasks nor verified_tasks_up_to. Recording it as VERIFIED would be the exact substitution NEX-090 exists to fix - a plausible stand-in for the exact value. A verdict may be anchored to a docs head only when `git diff <product> <docs-head> -- src/ tests/ frontend/ Dockerfile docker/ .github/` is empty, so the green run tested the identical tree. A run superseded in the concurrency group reads completed/cancelled - never a failure, never evidence. Recurring quirk: pushing product and docs as separate commits on one branch cancels the product commit's own runs, so the verdict must be taken from the docs head and licensed by the empty product diff.

decisions_this_run: meta.total is a COUNT over the same agent-scoped set as the page, not len(items). The count is scoped by agent_id because an unscoped count discloses another agent's volume - the leak NEX-088's mutation check found in this same shape of code.

resumable_only is exempt from paging. It is the recovery set, so a window would silently abandon runs. Its meta describes the set actually returned rather than echoing a limit the request did not apply.
limit is bounded ge=1, le=200 so a caller cannot reopen the unbounded read by asking.
list_for_agent orders by (created_at DESC, id DESC) so offset paging cannot duplicate or skip a row when created_at ties.
